contact.basis: Fixed landside palace contact before independent terrain sampling and all geometry; contemporary DEM not historical waterfront survey.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native whole Sher Garhi historical palace structure frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.2m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Unclassified steep hillside source relief may contain wall/canopy artifacts and does not resolve historical palace foundations, river levels or floor grades. Exact construction-grade classification is unspecified; source field does not certify ground contact.
